audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[].side hold the generic 'Skill' token while win[0-6] (content layer) reads Vel'Koz,Vel'Koz,Vel'Koz,Vel'Koz,Rakan,Vel'Koz,Rakan, matching the packet levelChart exactly.
audit.why: The chart badge would show a neutral 'Skill' label on every row while the prose text underneath and the packet both say Rakan clearly wins levels 6 and late — a reader gets no warning from the chart itself about the level-6 all-in or the late teamfight flank.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0-3].side and phases[5].side to Vel'Koz (why already matched, edited side alone). Set phases[4].side and phases[6].side to Rakan and rewrote their why to explain the W-into-R charm chain-CC and the late E/R flank, since the existing why text described Vel'Koz winning those rows.

audit.why: Level 6 W-into-R charm spike and first-item punish-the-dash spike are already grounded in the kit and stated in content.spikes[].

audit.whatIsWrong: The missingInteractions entry (Rakan's Gleaming Quill heals his side on hit; Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades) is not stated anywhere on the page.
audit.why: A support who doesn't time anti-heal against Rakan's Q sustain will lose poke wars they should win.

edits.before: Life Form Disintegration online — rooted duos meet the beam's thesis.
edits.after: Rakan's W-into-R charm chains crowd control before you can channel — respect the level-6 all-in instead of poking into it.

edits.before: Late Vel'Koz grades teamfights: E the entry, beam the formation, and fork the survivors.
edits.after: Late, his E double-dash and R roam flank your backline and land the charm before you finish channeling.

edits.before: Q-fork the pair, W the pulse, third-hit the research — true math their page can't answer.
edits.after: If he lands Grand Entrance and dives, your E knockup catches the follow-up before Battle Dance carries him back out.

edits.before: Beaming into a loaded engage — the channel is a verdict for fights already decided.
edits.after: Channeling your R while Rakan has Battle Dance banked for his ADC lets him tank the beam and counter-engage for free.

edits.before: - Rakan Grand Entrance: matchup-defining — The leap knockup starts every play — track him in fog; the E extends it. It writes your spacing rules. - E Tectonic Disruption is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Grand Entrance (W) is 14s at rank 1, 10s by rank 5 — the leap knockup starts every play; track him in fog. - Gleaming Quill (Q) heals his side on hit — hold Grievous Wounds for extended trades. - Your E is for saving fights, not seasoning trades; the R opens or closes one per cast.

notes: Fixed a level-chart/content disagreement across all 7 rows (side held the generic 'Skill' token while win[] and the packet both named a specific winner). Rows 4 and 6 needed side moved to Rakan plus a rewritten why since the old why text argued the opposite side; rows 0-3 and 5 already had why text matching the target side, so side was edited alone. Also added the missing anti-heal-timing interaction and fixed two copy-paste-bleed bullets and the no-digit cooldowns field.
